articles.title: Lane Kiffin, LSU Display 'Bloodbath' Quote from Ole Miss WR on Video Board at Practice
articles.summary: Lane Kiffin is making sure his team is fired up ahead of their matchup against Ole Miss on Saturday.
articles.body:
Lane Kiffin is making sure his team is fired up ahead of their matchup against Ole Miss on Saturday.

The LSU head coach put a quote from Ole Miss wide receiver Deuce Alexander on the team's video board during practice. Alexander said the game is going to be a "bloodbath."

"It's gonna be a great matchup," Alexander told reporters this week. "Just get ready; it's gonna be a bloodbath."

The matchup between the Tigers and Rebels this Saturday is sure to be on every college football fan's watchlist as Kiffin returns to his former team. Kiffin spent six seasons at Ole Miss before leaving for LSU last November.

Kiffin is expecting a hostile environment in Oxford, with all of that anger directed towards him rather than the team as a whole.

"I mean, I guess there's real safety issues and stuff, so there's people that have a plan for that. It is what it is," Kiffin told reporters on Monday. "But I told the players today, you don't have anything to worry about as far as attention on you all week. There's gonna be so much attention, hatred, everything on me that you just get to go play."

More than a meeting between a head coach and his former team, LSU and Ole Miss' matchup could have major SEC and College Football Playoff implications. Both teams are ranked inside the AP Top 10 after starting the season undefeated, and a win for either side would be a huge resume builder.

"That says to me it's the most relevant matchup of these two teams in 64 years," Kiffin said, per Brett Martel of the Associated Press. "So, I think that's a really neat thing that we were able to be part of building a program (in Mississippi) that Pete's doing a great job of continuing it as a top-10 program.

"When we got there, they had won four games (in 2019). And when we got here eight months ago, (the Tigers) were 7-6. So, I think it's a really good thing that I think a lot of people could look at it and say, 'Hey, both sides are doing really well, and both sides won.'"

The rivalry matchup between LSU and Ole Miss is almost always interesting, but it's fair to say that this is the most anticipated meeting in either program's history. The Rebels will be looking to prove they're better off without Kiffin, while Kiffin wants to send a message with a win over his former school.

Needless to say, all eyes will be on Oxford at 7:30 p.m. ET on Saturday.

articles.title: El Benfica asalta San Siro y siembre las dudas en el Milan de Amorim
articles.standfirst: Lukebakio y Kaminski hicieron los tantos del equipo luso
articles.summary: Lukebakio y Kaminski hicieron los tantos del equipo luso
articles.body: Un 0-2 en San Siro ante el Milan es un serio aviso para todos en la Europa League. El Benfica de Marco Silva asaltó la capital lombarda pese a sacar un once repleto de suplentes y demostró que las ocho victorias que suma entre todas las competiciones no son una mera casualidad. Lukebakio y Kaminski derrotaron a un Milan que no suma en su estreno europeo y solamente gana en dudas. Eran muchos los analistas que colocaban al Milan como uno de los grandes favoritos al triunfo en la Europa League pero el arranque no pudo dejar más dudas para los de Amorim. El luso se permitió el lujo de dejar en el banquillo a nombres como Modric, Rabiot, Mario Gila, Moreira o Pulisic... y el equipo lo acabó pagando. La primera parte, salvo por varias ocasiones generadas a través de disparos lejanos, fue un solar ofensivo del equipo 'rossonero'. Y en defensa la cosa no iba mucho mejor. Lukebakio, que ya había avisado de que iba a dar la noche a Bartesaghi, superó con facilidad al lateral italiano y definió al palo largo de Maignan desde la frontal del área. Era el 0-1. Minutos después, tras una recuperación alta, Sudakov remató a la madera. Intentó buscar una reacción al descanso Amorim con las entradas de Pulisic y Mario Gila pero la reacción fue escasa. De hecho, ocho minutos después de la reanudación, los lisboetas hacían el 0-2 por medio de Kaminski provocando que en el siempre acústico San Siro resonara música de viento. No hubo milagro 'rossonero'... y ya van tres partidos sin ganar para el 'Diavolo'. Modric, que se quedó sin minutos, tendrá que esperar al lunes para volver al terrano de juego y ser protagonista ante el Lecce. Un partido que no se le puede escapar a un Milan que empató con la Juventus (1-1), la Lazio (2-2)... y ahora cae en casa ante el Benfica.

articles.title: PLAYER RATINGS | Sturm Graz 0-0 Rennes: Wasteful Bretons held to Europa League stalemate

articles.body:
UEFA Europea League, Matchday 1, 16/09/2026

Rennes started their Europa League campaign with a disappointing draw against Sturm Graz. The visitors could not convert the many chances that fell their way.

937 days after their last European tie, in which Benjamin Bourigeaud scored a hat-trick against AC Milan , Rennes returned to the European stage. Les Rouge et Noir kicked off their Europa League campaign of the back of a strong start to the Ligue 1 season, with 10 points out of a possible 12.

Rennes thought they had an early lead in Styria with Adrien Thomasson scoring in back-to-back games, after he struck against Marseille last week. But the midfielder's effort was chalked off for handball. Both teams were particularly wasteful in those early exchanges. Rennes mostly struggled to break open Graz's five-men defense, but the hosts were toothless. Sturm Graz had a disallowed goal on their own with Paul-Friedrich Koller heading home Joshua Quarshie 's deflection, but the former was offside.

To encapsulate how low-quality the first half was, Sturm's first shot on target occured at the 38th minute. Still, barring an Estéban Lepaul attempt, Rennes were barely better going forward. The visitors lacked consistency, urgency and an edge in the final third.

The trend carried on in the second half. Lepaul missed more chances, and Sturm Graz started to feel blood. Brice Samba came up clutch to deny Belmin Beganovic, who easily breezed past Anthony Rouault . The second half proved a scrappy affair as both teams continued to spurn chance after chance through sheer clumsiness, as shown by Bryan Reynolds letting the ball out of bounds before he could cross it. The American full-back also wasted a point-blank chance.

In the end, a goalless draw is a fair reflection of how Sturm Graz and Rennes have been wasteful tonight. Les Rouge et Noir also had some late scares to eventually salvage a point. Rennes will host OFI Crete FC for Matchday 2 of the Europa League next month.

The France international goalkeeper had a mostly quiet night out in Austria , but everytime he was called upon, he emphatically answered, dishing out a couple of good saves. Solid in his distribution too.

The English defender kept it clean and tidy at the back. The former Toulouse FC has been a decent addition to the club's back-line following Jérémy Jacquet 's switch to Liverpool .

After an all-action cameo off the bench against Marseille, the Jordanian winger dropped off a level or two tonight. Although he put some decent crosses in, his decision-making was questionable, and he lost countless balls in the final third.

For his first European game of his career, the France international-hopeful didn't make an impression. He lacked ruthlessness in his finishing, his positioning was off (three offsides in the first half) and his hold-up play was found lacking.

articles.title: Sinisalo And Trusty Must Return | Predicted Celtic Lineup To Face Ferencvárosi In The Europa League
articles.summary: After a catastrophic defeat to bitter rivals Rangers in the season’s first Old Firm derby, Celtic will now begin their Europa League campaign, with Hungarian...
articles.body:
After a catastrophic defeat to bitter rivals Rangers in the season's first Old Firm derby, Celtic will now begin their Europa League campaign, with Hungarian heavyweights Ferencvárosi set to visit Parkhead on Thursday night. Confidence must be sky-high in the Greens' camp following an emphatic 7-0 win over Debreceni in the Magyar Kupa, unlike the Bhoys, who were eliminated from the League Cup last weekend in a one-sided encounter.

These two sides previously clashed heads in 2021, when the Celts won both home and away in the group stage of the 2021-22 season. However, Ferencvárosi knocked them out of the Champions League qualifiers in 2020, and the gaffer Martin O'Neill must demand a reaction from his men in Europe.

Predicted 4-2-3-1 Celtic Lineup To Face Ferencvárosi

Sam Johnstone grabbed back-to-back starts between the sticks, but could make way for Viljami Sinisalo , who has hardly put a foot wrong since being promoted as the first-choice custodian earlier this year after Kasper Schmeichel 's injury.

GLASGOW, SCOTLAND – AUGUST 26: James Forrest of Celtic battles for possession with Eldar Civic of Ferencvaros during the UEFA Champions League: Second Qualifying Round match between Celtic and Ferencvaros at Celtic Park on August 26, 2020 in Glasgow, Scotland. (Photo by Ian MacNicol/Getty Images)

With Alistair Johnston still sidelined, the veteran Northern Irish boss should once again rely on Colby Donovan down the right ahead of new signing Jordan Lotomba and Anthony Ralston . Cameron Carter-Vickers had a nightmare at Ibrox, but his experience would be key in such a high-voltage fixture. Despite getting the nod over Auston Trusty on Sunday afternoon, Liam Scales might make way for the USMNT centre-back to partner his compatriot in the heart of the backline. Kieran Tierney is expected to keep his place down the left for the balance he brings between attack and defence.

Celtic have no like-for-like alternative for skipper Callum McGregor , who remains irreplaceable deep in midfield despite being a shadow of his earlier self. With Alex Oxlade-Chamberlain suspended for the midweek clash and Joel van den Berg left out of the 25-man list, O'Neill is left with Mika Baur and Oliver Sørensen as the only available central midfield options. Baur fits better as a 'double pivot', but the latter must appear from the bench to inject more energy and directness in the middle of the park.

Benjamin Nygren has been effective with his end product while featuring as a 'number 10'. The Swedish ace is the obvious starter, but Yang Hyun-jun's absence for international commitments could force the manager to bank on Camilo Duran as a makeshift left-sided attacker. The versatile forward would be a far better option than Sebastian Tounekti and James Forrest. Haissem Hassan , back to full fitness, should retain his starting status down the right.

Club-record signing Kasper Hogh has been highly disappointing since his hat-trick against Kilmarnock early in the season. But the Danish hitman could still spearhead the attack amid Shim Mheuka's omission from the Europa League squad, Callum Osmand 's injury, and dependency on Duran in wide areas.

articles.title: Imanol Alguacil se estrena en Olympiacos con una gran remontada
articles.standfirst: Dieron la vuelta al 0-1 del Jagiellonia en el Pireo
articles.summary: Dieron la vuelta al 0-1 del Jagiellonia en el Pireo
articles.body: Después de debutar en casa el pasado sábado con derrota ante el OFI Creta (0-1), Imanol Alguacil sumó su primera victoria como entrenador de Olympiacos. La sombra de Mendilibar es larga en el Pireo... pero la forma que tiene el técnico de Orio de construir su propia historia es a través de victorias. Y ante el Jagiellonia, un equipo con bastante bagaje europeo las últimas temporadas, no lo tuvo fácil. Le tocó remontar tras empezar perdiendo 0-1 en casa por el gol de Szmyt. Una muy buena transición ofensiva de los polacos después del gravísimo error de Ortega en salida de balón. Pero hubo remontada. Primero anotó el méxicano Armando González aprovechando un rechace; después, ya en la segunda parte, Yaremchuk cabeceó a gol para certificar el triunfo y sumar los primeros tres puntos de la 'fase liga' para los helenos. Más fácil lo tuvo el Bayer Leverkusen ante un Celje que tuvo sus momentos en la primera parte. Pero no sufrió en exceso el equipo del español Carles Martínez, que venía de empatar en Bundesliga ante el Augsburgo. Primero Seslas en propia puerta y después el argentino Facundo Medina (a pase de Aleix García) hicieron los tantos de los germanos. También ganó el Lyon en su visita a Bruselas. Los de Fonseca se impusieron al Anderlecht 1-2 tras los tempraneros goles de Narte y Nakamura, ambos en los primeros 20 minutos de partido. 'Les Mauves' intentaron reengancharse en la segunda parte con el 1-2 de Cvetkovic pero los galos resistieron bien. Y victoria en casa para uno de los equipos Premier de la competición. El Sunderland, que recibía al siempre valiente AZ Alkmaar neerlandés, ganó 1-0 con un tanto de penalti de Enzo Le Fee. El mediapunta galo hizo un partidazo pero solamente desde los 11 metros estuvo acertado de cara al arco rival.

articles.title: Man Utd 2-3 Brighton: Michael Carrick's side collapse from 2-0 up to exit Carabao Cup at the first hurdle once again
articles.summary: Report and free match highlights as Manchester United throw away a two-goal lead to exit the Carabao Cup; Shea Lacey and Mason Mount put Michael Carrick's side 2-0 up inside 10 minutes; Charampalos Kostoulas, Pascal Gross and Maxim De Cuyper turned the cup tie on its head
articles.body:
It is the first time in 50 years that United have held a 2-0 lead at Old Trafford and lost the game. They had won 143 out of the 145 previous times they had raced into such an advantage.

Yet it was all going to plan for Michael Carrick's side as they looked to respond to the Manchester derby defeat, as talented teen Shea Lacey and Mason Mount put them ahead after 10 minutes.

But United began sleepwalking towards defeat - failing to register another shot on target until the 76th minute - and Brighton, who made six changes for this cup tie, took advantage.

After Charalampos Kostoulas pulled one back on the stroke of half-time after questionable goalkeeping from Karl Darlow, the Seagulls struck twice in four second-half minutes through Pascal Gross and substitute Maxim De Cuyper to stun Old Trafford into silence.

Bruno Fernandes was then brought on as an emergency substitute, before Marcus Rashford missed a one-on-one chance to level the cup tie.

This was not quite the second-round embarrassment at Grimsby that Ruben Amorim suffered last season, but Carrick now has a lot of questions his way as one of United's realistic trophy hopes disappears for another year.

8: GOAL! Lacey initially makes it a dream full United debut by skipping past two Brighton defenders before finding the near post

9: GOAL! Forty-three seconds after the restart, Mount makes it 2-0 after Jason Steele saved from Rashford.

36: BIG CHANCE! Brighton respond well after the early double deficit but Malick Yalcouye curls a one-on-one chance wide.

45+1: GOAL! Kostoulas beats Karl Darlow to a long ball into the box and slots in a leveller, despite United complaints Benjamin Sesko had been fouled in the build-up.

65: GOAL! Gross converts from close range after Sesko headed the ball back to him after losing 50:50.

69: GOAL! Old Trafford is stunned as substitute Diego Gomez goes on lengthy run and crosses for De Cuyper, who finishes from close range.

76: HUGE CHANCE! Marcus Rashford is played through on goal but his near-post finish is kept out by Steele.

84: TWO CHANCES! Brighton miss a double chance to seal the game as Kostoulas' effort is cleared off the line by Leny Yoro, before Gomez's shot is saved by Darlow.

articles.title: Coventry 1-3 Aston Villa: Tammy Abraham scores twice as Unai Emery's side cruise into Carabao Cup fourth round
articles.summary: Match report and highlights as Aston Villa beat Coventry City 3-1 to book their place in the fourth round of the Carabao Cup; Tammy Abraham scored twice and Ross Barkley also netted; Victor Torp scored the pick of the goals with a stunning free-kick
articles.body:
Abraham raced through on goal to give Unai Emery's side an early lead, just their second domestic goal of the season, but it was quickly cancelled out by Victor Torp's stunning free-kick into the top right corner.

The lead was restored just before the break through Ross Barkley's glancing header from Ibrahim Mbaye's corner, with the 18-year-old winger impressing throughout on his first start for the club since his £47m move from Paris Saint-Germain this summer.

Abraham, who had offers to leave before Deadline Day but stayed to fight for his place, helped himself to a second with a simple finish from close range as Villa brushed aside their goalscoring woes to ease into the next round of the cup.

The fixture marked the first meeting between the two sides since the 3-2 win for Villa in 2001, which relegated the Sky Blues from the Premier League, and now compounds a tough start to the season for Frank Lampard's side.

They have just one win across their opening five games and will now prepare to face Nottingham Forest, live on Saturday Night Football , in search of their first Premier League goal after returning to the top flight.

articles.title: Everton 1-0 Wolves: Charly Alcaraz hits late winner to send Toffees through to Carabao Cup fourth round
articles.summary: Report and free match highlights from the Carabao Cup third-round tie between Everton and Wolves at the Hill Dickinson Stadium; sub Charly Alcaraz hits late winner to send Toffees into fourth round in deserved win over much-changed Championship side in front of UK PM Andy Burnham
articles.body:
Alcaraz's 80th-minute strike came just three minutes after coming off the bench, and it maintained Everton's unbeaten start to the season.

It was just Alcaraz's second goal for the club, having scored 13 months ago in this competition.

Everton were deserved winners over the Championship side, who made nine changes from last weekend's league win at Sheffield United.

Wolves' goalscoring hero at Bramall Lane, Raul Jimenez, was given a start, but he was concerningly taken off midway through the first half with an injury.

Wolves debutant Joao Virginia was in inspired form against his old club as he pulled off a magnificent close-range save to deny Thierno Barry's header in first-half stoppage time.

Virginia's opposite number Jordan Pickford made a good save to deny Jimenez's replacement Adam Armstrong early in the second half, which was the visitors' first shot on target of the game.

Virginia then denied Everton substitute Brennan Johnson, but he could do nothing to stop Alcaraz's powerful curling strike from inside the area late on.

It was a goal that gave on-watching UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham and his Canadian counterpart and fellow Everton fan Mark Carney plenty of joy as David Moyes' side remain in the hunt to earn their first silverware since 1995.
